content: TinyGPSPlus (NMEA-only, simplest API, most popular for ESP32 hobbyist GPS) vs NeoGPS (more RAM-efficient, compile-time sentence filtering, steeper API) vs SparkFun u-blox GNSS Arduino Library (full NMEA+UBX support over I2C/Serial/SPI, needed for UBX config/power-save messages, heavier). For simple lat/lon/speed/course/altitude parsing TinyGPSPlus is the de facto standard; UBX binary config (power save, sentence filtering, update rate) is typically done via raw byte arrays or the SparkFun library.
